scope: 64,000 customers; randomized email campaign; two-week outcomes; single historical experiment, not prospective validation

split.unit: source row, no user identifier available

selection: For each outcome choose model on validation paired policy-value gain vs response ranking at cap 0.3; never select on test
ranking: max arm CATE; fixed cap, deterministic row-index tie break; no individual causal-type labels
estimator: Horvitz-Thompson policy increment against no email, known p=1/3; paired differences against response and historical-value rules
interval: pointwise normal 95% interval over held-out row contributions, conditional on fixed learned policy; not retraining/multiple-comparison/individual intervals
financial: spend is two-week sales USD, not profit; contact cost and margin are user-entered assumptions, zero by default
license: Publisher released for public challenge; no explicit standard redistribution license verified. Local research only; raw data and sample-level records excluded from public build.
